aboutText: Pratz Earthworks is a trusted earthworks company based in Heidelberg West, Victoria. With years of experience serving the local community, we specialise in all aspects of earth moving, including excavation, site preparation, and drainage. Our team is committed to delivering high-quality workmanship on time and within budget. Whether it's a small backyard project or a large commercial site, we have the equipment and expertise to handle it.
servicesText: From initial site clearance to final grading, we provide a full range of earthworks services. Our skilled team uses modern equipment to ensure efficient and precise work on every project.

services.title: Excavation
services.desc: We handle all types of excavation, from trenches to large-scale earth removal, ensuring accurate and safe work.

services.title: Site Preparation
services.desc: Complete site clearing and levelling to prepare your land for construction or landscaping projects.

services.title: Drainage Solutions
services.desc: Installation of effective drainage systems to prevent water pooling and ensure proper water flow on your property.

services.title: Foundation Work
services.desc: Solid foundation preparation for buildings, sheds, and other structures, with precise excavation and compaction.

services.title: Landscaping Earthworks
services.desc: Shaping the land for gardens, driveways, and outdoor areas, including soil import and export.

services.title: Demolition & Removal
services.desc: Safe demolition of existing structures and removal of debris, clearing the way for new developments.
